 Start learning with core training 
1. Introduction to Axure RP
Get started with an overview of creating and sharing prototypes in Axure RP.
2. Working with pages
In this training, you'll learn how to add, organize, and style pages in Axure RP.
3. Widgets & components
Learn how to add, edit, and style widgets and create reusable components in Axure RP.
4. Interactions
Learn the basics of interactions in Axure RP, from simple links to showing multiple flows.
5. Dynamic panels
Learn about dynamic panels, an incredibly useful widget for rapid prototyping.
6. Sharing your prototypes
Publish prototypes to Axure Cloud to share with your team, stakeholders, and users.
 Contact our support team by emailing us at support@axure.com
 The Axure Support Team can help you get the most out of Axure RP by answering questions like “How do I prototype this?” or “Is there an easier way?” 
 Our team is also your best point of contact for feature requests, bug fixes, technical troubleshooting and more.
